name: Gasthof Eppensteiner
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthof Eppensteiner in Navis** – a cozy retreat nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** countryside, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. Here, traditional Tyrolean hospitality meets rustic charm, offering you a warm and authentic escape.

Indulge in our **Kaiserschmarrn**, fluffy and caramelized, served with fresh fruit compote—a classic Austrian breakfast to start your day. Savor hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, a rustic potato and bacon dish, or enjoy our locally sourced meats and seasonal specialties prepared with care.

After a day of exploring the stunning **Zillertal** or hiking through the **Karwendel** mountains, unwind in our cozy common room by the fireplace. Sample a glass of **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** with a shot of **Obstler** (fruit brandy) or relax with a cup of homemade **Kaffee** and a slice of **Sachertorte**.

Our family-run inn offers comfortable rooms with mountain views, ensuring a peaceful night’s sleep. Whether you’re here for adventure, relaxation, or a taste of **Tirol**’s culinary delights, Gasthof Eppensteiner promises an unforgettable stay in the pure spirit of the Alps.

**Willkommen im Gasthof Eppensteiner in Navis!**
